purpose: One added element over predict-v1: a single conditioning feature for the expected open-to-open simple price return, estimated with the same expanding conditional-mean estimator as P2, scored against P1 for incremental conditional predictive content. Forecast study only; no h combination, no allocation change, no orders.
unchanged_from_predict_v1: decision at close i; pool j >= 199 and j+2 <= i; j = i-1 excluded
update order: matured label j = i-2 assigned to the cell observed at its own decision j, then current cell, then emit
common eligible pool j >= 199 for all variants
metrics family: MSE, paired differences whole and by entry year, uncentered cross moment, centered covariance, sign accuracy (mu != 0, y != 0), mu mean/sd, counts; no OLS, p-values, PnL
resources: CPU 1, external timeout 60, optimizer fits 0, expanding means only, API 0, orders 0
selftest: synthetic fixtures/perturbations/envelope only; real data hashes/calendar/counts only

new_element.name: P3_sign_prev_return_conditional_mean
new_element.feature: c_i = 1 if adjusted C[i] > adjusted C[i-1] else 0 (equality -> 0); the sign of the latest completed adjusted close-to-close return, observed at close i
new_element.why_this_first: simplest conditioning variable that is fresh at close i (P2's MA200 regime is slow-moving); adjusted closes avoid distribution-date gaps; two cells keep the estimator identical to P2 so only the conditioning variable changes
new_element.mu_hat: expanding mean of y_j over the common mature pool with c_j == c_i; if the cell is empty use the contemporaneous P1 mean (count), 0 if P1 also empty
new_element.sample_invariant: n_cell0 + n_cell1 == n_P1 at every decision
new_element.design_constants: two cells by strict sign; no magnitude threshold; not tuned

variants_in_run: P2_ma200_conditional_mean (recomputed identically for paired comparison, not re-scored as a new finding)
primary_comparison: mean paired squared-error difference P3 - P1, whole period and by entry year (incremental content of the sign cell over the unconditional mean)
secondary_comparisons: cell diagnostics: samples per cell at first scored decision and at the end; final per-cell pool means (descriptive, computed from stored records, never fed back)
pre_declared_scale: If the in-sample close-to-close AC1 of about -0.05 seen in market_model carried fully into the open-to-open target, the MSE reduction over P1 would be of order 0.25%; the target skips the close-to-open gap, so less is expected. Any smaller or opposite-signed result is a legitimate outcome, not a bug.
verification_required: synthetic fixture: cells by hand incl. equality -> 0, cell attribution at the label's own decision j, exact P3 means, P1 fallback when a cell is empty, pool invariant
perturbation: changing adjusted C after k leaves decisions <= k unchanged; changing adjusted C[k] may change decision k's cell only; raw O perturbations as in predict-v1
constant-price case through build_payload (null ratios preserved in JSON, '해당 없음' in summary)
real data: hashes (raw, adjusted, spec) before and after, calendar facts equal to predict-v1 spec values, counts; no real-data estimation in selftest
P1 and P2 real-data outputs must equal predict-v1 stored values to the float (regression check against 01601fb9) before the new variant is scored

outputs.envelope: contract v3; parents raw, adjusted, spec, predict_v1_results (regression anchor)

prohibited_in_this_run: choosing the feature, cell count or threshold after outcomes
adding more than this one feature
combining mu with state h or allocation weights
calling an MSE or cross-moment difference a trading edge
alternatives_not_run_listed_for_bill: three cells by magnitude of the latest adjusted return (< -1%, within 1%, > +1%) with 1% as a design constant
12-month (250-session) momentum sign C[i] > C[i-250] (slow trend like MA200; expected to overlap P2)
drawdown state C[i]/max(C[<=i]) - 1 below -10% (dip logic of ladder R4)
volatility state from state-vol-v1 (requires separate approval of h use)
open_choices_for_bill: sign of adjusted close-to-close (drafted) vs raw
two cells (drafted) vs three magnitude cells
keep common pool j >= 199 (drafted) vs feature-specific pool
include P2 recomputation in the run (drafted) or compare P3 only against stored predict-v1 P1/P2
